items.title: Jimmy Heath — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: If I write a piece for Picasso, or if I write a piece for Monet, or whoever they wanted be to write for…

ctx.x: Yeah, he was supposed to do another one himself, which is like a concert dedicated to the visual artists. If I write a piece for Picasso, or if I write a piece for Monet, or whoever they wanted be to write for… Wynton was supposed to do a mullasif and he got jammed. Wynton only took one lesson, or something. He took one lesson for me about writing and never came back. He said, “Man, you showed me so much in that one lesson,” and now I say, “Well, can I get a lesson from you?” Wynton Marsalis is writing some of…
